metadata.overview: Bitcoin market data from the public mempool.space API: BTC price, its history, network hashrate, network hashprice, the fee share of block rewards and the fee rate. One device per API endpoint; no credentials.

telemetry.name: price
telemetry.description: Current BTC price: { ts, usd }. An object, since the contract unit vocabulary has no currency.

telemetry.name: price_history
telemetry.description: BTC price in USD with a time in [start, end] (ms): [{ ts, usd }]. Hourly for recent months, coarser before.

telemetry.name: network_hashrate
telemetry.description: Daily average network hashrate with a time in [start, end] (ms): [{ ts, hashrateHs }], in H/s. Up to three years back.

telemetry.name: hashprice
telemetry.description: Daily network hashprice with a time in [start, end] (ms): [{ ts, btcPerPhsDay, usdPerPhsDay }]: one day's block rewards (subsidy and fees) per PH/s of network hashrate. Up to two years back.

telemetry.name: fee_share
telemetry.description: Daily share of block rewards paid as transaction fees, with a time in [start, end] (ms): [{ ts, feeShare }], feeShare in [0, 1]. Splits a pool payout into subsidy and fees when the pool doesn't. Up to two years back.

telemetry.name: fee_rate
telemetry.description: Daily typical transaction fee rate with a time in [start, end] (ms): [{ ts, feeRateSatsVb }], in sats/vB: the mean of the day's median block fee rates. Up to two years back.

errors.ERR_MEMPOOL_UNREACHABLE: The mempool.space API did not answer.
errors.ERR_MEMPOOL_BAD_RESPONSE: The mempool.space API answered with an unexpected body.
